raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fixes #65171. HunyuanOCR checkpoints from before the 2026-08-26 config update fail at engine startup with `RuntimeError: shape '[-1, 16, 192]' is invalid`. The Transformers backend sizes the attention heads at 192 while the model uses 128.

No other PR addresses this. The issue has no comments or linked PRs, and searches for `65171`, `HunyuanOCR` and `HunyuanVL head_dim` turned up no open PRs.

## Claims

- HunyuanOCR at revision `449e7d47` (the last revision whose config has `kv_lora_rank`) starts up and runs OCR correctly. On `main` it crashes during `profile_run`.
- A config that sets `use_mla: false` is no longer treated as MLA by the Transformers backend: neither when sizing attention heads in `_create_attention_instances`, nor in `ModelConfig.use_mla`.
- Configs without a `use_mla` key (e.g. DeepSeek V2/V3) are unchanged.

## Validation

**Reproducer.** L4 (Colab), torch 2.14.0+cu132, transformers 5.22.1. `main` is the merge base `e8570ef757`, and "this PR" is `d2161b693b`. The script renders the text "vLLM issue 65171" into an image, runs HunyuanOCR on it and prints what vLLM built:

```bash
python repro_65171.py 449e7d471a8a1ef5bd5d652e4881183d7252cbc7        # legacy config
python repro_65171.py 47644ecc4fc854efa4f505155158831f36773ee4        # current config
```

<details>
<summary>repro_65171.py</summary>

```python
"""Reproducer for vllm-project/vllm#65171.

python repro_65171.py <hf_revision> [auto|transformers]
"""

import sys

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
from vllm.config import ModelConfig, ParallelConfig

MODEL = "tencent/HunyuanOCR"


def attn_layers(model):
    return sorted(
        {
            (type(m).__name__, m.head_size, m.num_kv_heads)
            for m in model.modules()
            if type(m).__name__ in ("Attention", "MLAAttention")
        }
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    rev = sys.argv[1]
    impl = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "auto"
    mc = ModelConfig(MODEL, revision=rev, model_impl=impl)
    print(
        f"[config] use_mla={mc.use_mla} head_size={mc.get_head_size()} "
        f"num_kv_heads={mc.get_num_kv_heads(ParallelConfig())}"
    )

    llm = LLM(
        MODEL,
        revision=rev,
        model_impl=impl,
        max_model_len=4096,
        limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 1, "video": 0},
        enforce_eager=True,
    )
    print(f"[layers] (cls, head_size, num_kv_heads) = {llm.apply_model(attn_layers)}")

    img = Image.new("RGB", (640, 160), "white")
    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=48)
    ImageDraw.Draw(img).text((20, 50), "vLLM issue 65171", fill="black", font=font)
    messages = [
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": [
                {"type": "image_pil", "image_pil": img},
                {"type": "text", "text": "Extract the text in the image."},
            ],
        }
    ]
    out = llm.chat(messages, SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=32))
    print(f"[output] {out[0].outputs[0].text!r}")
```

`apply_model` needs `VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1`.
</details>

| Code | HF revision | `ModelConfig` (use_mla / head_size) | Attention layers built (head_size, KV heads) | KV cache | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `main` | `449e7d47` (legacy) | False / 128 | (crashes before this) | — | `RuntimeError: shape '[-1, 16, 192]' is invalid for input of size 16777216` |
| this PR | `449e7d47` (legacy) | False / 128 | `Attention` (128, 8) | 184,832 tokens | `图片中的文本内容是：vLLM issue 65171` ("the text in the image is: vLLM issue 65171") |
| `main` | `47644ecc` (current) | False / 128 | `Attention` (128, 8) | 184,832 tokens | same output |
| this PR | `47644ecc` (current) | False / 128 | `Attention` (128, 8) | 184,832 tokens | same output |

With the fix, the legacy checkpoint builds exactly the same attention layers and KV cache as the current one, and gives the same output.

**Unit tests** (red on base, green with fix). One covers each call site:

```bash
# The head_size override in _create_attention_instances, the line that crashed.
# With the old kv_lora_rank guard: opt-out case fails with `assert 192 == 16`. Fix: 2 passed.
pytest tests/models/transformers/test_backend.py -k test_full_attention_head_size_respects_use_mla
# ModelConfig.use_mla. Base: 1 failed, 1 passed. Fix: 2 passed.
pytest tests/test_config.py -k test_transformers_backend_use_mla
```

**Real MLA path unchanged** (L4, Colab): `pytest tests/models/transformers/test_backend.py::test_mla` passes. It runs `hmellor/tiny-random-DeepseekV2ForCausalLM` through `MLAAttention`.

`tests/models/transformers/fusers/test_mla.py::test_update_forward_rewrites_real_attention` fails the same way with and without this change on my local transformers 5.13, so that failure is unrelated.

## Details

**Root cause.** Older HunyuanOCR `config.json` revisions carry MLA fields (`kv_lora_rank=512`, `qk_nope_head_dim=128`, `qk_rope_head_dim=64`) together with `use_mla: false` and `head_dim: 128`. The model itself uses dense attention. With the default `model_impl`:

1. `ModelConfig.use_mla` is already False on `main`, so `_get_attn_cls` picks `Attention` without trying MLA.
2. `_create_attention_instances` treats any `kv_lora_rank` as MLA. For an MLA model that runs on full attention, it overwrites `head_size` with `qk_nope_head_dim + qk_rope_head_dim = 192`.
3. The HF attention module still produces 128-dim heads, so `query.view(-1, 16, 192)` fails in `profile_run`.

**Fix.** A shared `transformers_uses_mla()` helper in `vllm/transformers_utils/config.py` treats `kv_lora_rank` as MLA unless the config explicitly sets `use_mla=False`. A missing or `None` value keeps the existing behaviour.

- `_create_attention_instances` uses it. This is the change that fixes #65171.
- `ModelConfig.use_mla` uses it on the Transformers backend path, so the two checks can't disagree. That path is only taken when `using_transformers_backend()` is True, i.e. with `--model-impl transformers` for HunyuanOCR. There, `main` reports `use_mla=True` with 1 KV head and this PR reports `use_mla=False` with 8. End-to-end, HunyuanOCR with `--model-impl transformers` fails at engine startup with a bare `AssertionError` from EngineCore on both `main` and this PR, whichever `use_mla` value is picked, so that path is covered by the unit test only; I will open a separate issue once I have the full traceback.

`_create_attention_instances` can't read `model_config.use_mla` instead. When MLA fusion fails, `_get_attn_cls` sets `VLLM_MLA_DISABLE=1`, so `use_mla` turns False for exactly the real MLA models that still need the head_size override.

---
